tools.name: post_send_numeric_verify
tools.description: Sends a six-digit verification code to a phone number by SMS and returns the code, so you can compare it with what the user types. The message reads `123-456 is your verification code. Don't share.` The request is charged the message's cost in credits (`cost`), which depends on the destination count

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: What a verification SMS costs in every country it can be sent to, in credits, sorted by country name. Each country is priced for a typical mobile number and checked at least once a day (`checked_at`, UTC); carriers within a country can differ, so use Estimate Cost for an exact number. Countries SMS

tools.name: post_estimate_cost
tools.description: What a verification SMS to this phone number would cost, in credits, and the number's country (`region_code`, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; `null` when the number belongs to no assigned range). Nothing is sent. The price is for this number's carrier, so it can differ from the country's price in the price list

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "sms-verify" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_estimate_cost · Public sink: post_send_numeric_verify, get_pricing, post_estimate_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_estimate_cost · Public sink: post_send_numeric_verify, get_pricing, post_estimate_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "post_estimate_cost" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Estimate Cost Billing per call: 0 Credits." → after: "What a verification SMS to this phone number would cost, in credits, and the number's country (`region_code`, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; `null` when the number belongs to no assigned range). Nothing is sent. The price is for this number's carrier, so it can differ from the country's price in the price list"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
